notClaimed: No `src/` file was changed. The campaign-channel seam stays out of scope: that channel has no ack-based queue bound, and adding one would be a product change outside this unit's ownership paths.

The client-side queue reading is APPLICATION level - delivered-but-unpainted envelopes and their serialized bytes - not `socket.bufferedAmount`, which finding #19 records as sitting at 0 on match traffic.
Frame bytes are the received string's length, within a few bytes of the wire rather than identical to it.
The build's hydrate step did not run; the row was proven against `node server.js` in production mode serving the prebuilt `.next`, not against a hydrated standalone bundle.
The `all` union was NOT run end to end here - only the new `backpressure` group and its membership pin. A 9-minute union run is a separate local/nightly proof (tasks.md 22.4).
